attachments.origin_landmark: superior border of the scapula, near the suprascapular notch
attachments.insertion_landmark: hyoid body, via an intermediate tendon slung by a fascial loop to the clavicle

functional_compartments.name: Inferior belly
functional_compartments.function_note: Runs obliquely from the scapula to the intermediate tendon, deep to sternocleidomastoid.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

functional_compartments.name: Superior belly
functional_compartments.function_note: Runs from the intermediate tendon up to the hyoid, more superficially than the inferior belly -- two-bellied like digastric, but (unlike digastric) both bellies share the same nerve supply since both derive from the same hypaxial muscle mass rather than two different pharyngeal arches.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)

source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
